events.verdict: Zeller (CHA) and Bryant (WAS) make incidental contact with one another during rebounding.
[Observable in enhanced video] Bryant (WAS) slides his pivot foot after securing the rebound.
Bryant (WAS) is already in Walker's (CHA) path and does not deliver contact.
RAR shows Batum (CHA) maintains legal guarding position and makes incidental contact with Beal (WAS) that does not affect his SQBR.
MOB and RAR show Zeller (CHA) jumps A to B into Beal's (WAS) path and makes body contact that affects his driving shot attempt.
Williams (CHA) is already in Beal's (WAS) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Beal (WAS) and Batum (CHA) briefly engage and separate off ball.
Bryant (WAS) is already in Batum's (CHA) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
RLB shows Zeller (CHA) absorbs body contact but then makes contact with Beal's (WAS) arm that affects his driving shot attempt.
Kidd-Gilchrist (CHA) commits a take foul on Satoransky (WAS).
All technical fouls are reviewed by League Operations.
Williams (CHA) commits a take foul on Green (WAS).
Williams (CHA) is already in Beal's (WAS) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
LLS shows Bryant (WAS) does not maintain legal guarding position and he makes contact with Zeller's (CHA) arm that affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Williams (CHA) cleanly deflects the ball away from Green (WAS).
Green (WAS) legally contests Walker's (CHA) shot attempt.
Zeller (CHA) makes incidental contact to Bryant's (WAS) head/neck area during rebounding.
Graham (CHA) extends his arms into Satoransky (WAS) and affects his SQBR in the backcourt.
LLS shows Satoransky (WAS) maintains legal guarding position as he defends Walker's (CHA) driving shot attempt.
Kidd-Gilchrist (CHA) and Beal (WAS) engage during the inbound but disengage without affecting each other's freedom of movement.
Williams (CHA) commits a take foul on Beal (WAS).
Randle (WAS) makes marginal contact with Walker (CHA) that does not affect his ability to pass.
Green's (WAS) right foot steps out of bounds and he legally inbounds the ball.

Walker (CHA) makes contact to Ariza's (WAS) body and the contact occurs after Ariza's gather. After communicating with the Replay Center, it was determined the contact did not meet the criteria for a Clear Path foul and Walker was assessed a common foul.
